entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by network to initiate authentication procedure.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE
entities.description: Message sent by UE in response to authentication challenge.

entities.name: Timer T3516
entities.description: Timer used during authentication procedure to manage RAND/RES* storage.

entities.name: KAMF derivation
entities.description: Procedure where UE derives new KAMF from 5G authentication challenge data.

entities.name: RAND storage condition
entities.description: Condition where UE stores RAND and RES* in volatile memory to avoid synchronization failure.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: 5GMM state where UE is not registered with the network.

entities.name: 5GMM-NULL
entities.description: Initial 5GMM state where no NAS signaling connection exists.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE
entities.description: 5GMM state where UE has no active NAS signaling connection.

entities.name: RAND and RES* deletion
entities.description: Property describing when stored RAND and RES* values are deleted from UE memory.

relations.description: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message triggers UE to send AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message.
KAMF derivation is part of the authentication response procedure.
RAND storage condition starts timer T3516 when new RAND is received.
RAND deletion property stops timer T3516 when triggered.
RAND deletion occurs when UE enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.
RAND deletion occurs when UE enters 5GMM-NULL state.
RAND deletion occurs when UE enters 5GMM-IDLE mode.
